author: Amanjeet Singh
prior_information: Source workbook definitions, date coverage, 2015 blank rows and official calendar, yield-curve methodology and series coverage known. No AF-benchmark covariance or conditional strength result has been fitted or inspected. No production response has been fitted.
primary_candidate: Daily close-to-close change on the AF announcement date in the AAA euro-area sovereign spot-yield slope y1Y-y3M, expressed in percentage points. Difference uses the latest previous common observed business close, with both maturity dates identical. This is a government-bond slope change, not OIS or a pure policy expectation.
timing_basis: ECB methodology uses previous-business-day closing prices for noon publication. Official data portal shows an observation dated 11 June 2026 with publication update 12 June 2026 noon, supporting TIME_PERIOD as market observation date. No automatic publication-date shift will be applied.
date_checks: Duplicates, nonfinite rates, paired-date differences, unavailable event closes and previous closes, calendar gaps. August and September 2004 AF events precede the available curve and are retained in the exclusion inventory.
2015_zero_rows: The eight official monetary-policy meetings match the eight dated AF rows. February, May, August and November are no scheduled monetary-policy meeting months, not missing meeting surprises. For a calendar-month instrument they are zero within the verified sample coverage, not zero after January 2016.
conditional_source_fit: OLS daily candidate on intercept and AF normalized Target_1M, Delphic_1Y and Odyssean_1Y; report coefficient, source-only covariance/correlation, partial R2, classical and HC3 standard errors and squared t diagnostics, rank/leverage. This is financial source-validation, not the final monthly macroeconomic first stage and not proof of exclusion.
companion_enumeration: Change in government forward yield for months four through twelve: (y1Y-.25*y3M)/.75
selection: Do not choose a companion or sign convention based on significance. Retain every declared calculation, including weak or adverse results.
